narrative.northStar: An insurer's homepage that reads like the audit it invites - the numbers are the design, and everything else gets out of their way.
narrative.overview: A brand-faithful refresh of a single-page member-governed health plan site. Palette and typography are pinned; what changes is execution - the signature cost ledger leads its own hero, the ad-hoc 17-step scale becomes seven, vertical hierarchy stops being carried by ground colour alone, the rationed gold splits into an AA-passing light-ground value, and navigation survives below 900px.
keyCharacteristics: Numerals set in a dedicated monospace face, right-aligned into ledger columns
Four warm grounds doing the section separation, two padding tiers doing the ranking
One shadow, reserved for cards on dark grounds; two radii; zero photographs
The birch lenticel - the logo's own construction - as the one repeated decorative mark
Investigative CTA vocabulary with a single repeated primary action
rules: Zero raster images. The hero asset is the ledger table.
No fabricated content: every figure, address, date and name comes from the capture or renders as [data-placeholder].
Desktop section padding stays within 40-64px on every variant (multi-audience density floor).
The Transparency footer column, the language-access topbar and the ledger-as-hero are locked IA priorities.
Motion is declared per variant in DESIGN-<id>.json only; A and B render static.
dos: Let a table be the largest thing in the first viewport
Rule sections with the lenticel dash rather than adding a new divider vocabulary
Keep all 32 investigative CTA labels and repeat one primary across the page
donts: Introduce a font or a colour outside the captured surface
Replace the ledger hero with a headline-and-photo composition
Imply live data anywhere on the page
